Since you liked the National Geographic look on the Bingham, our floor-standing pick in that same style is the Replogle Kingsley 16" Floor Globe - Illuminated National Geographic Design. It's a true statement piece: illuminated for day/night viewing, with the National Geographic cartography you were just looking at, on its own floor stand. You'll find it under that exact name in search, ready to add to your cart.

Is this one for an office or a living space?
